The Black Hole Compressor's job, done beside a real black hole. The module is its §bown machine§r in the KEE's south arc, with its own GUI and hatches, so nothing on the KEE changes when you use it.

§e§lBUILD§r
- Place this controller where the KEE's hologram shows §bmarker 7§r, facing out of the cage.
- Project the arc from the module's own controller (33 × 11 × 20, one tier).
- 7 arc sockets take input buses or hatches, output buses or hatches, and 1 laser or up to 2 energy hatches. No maintenance hatch.

§e§lRUN§r GT's Compressor and Neutronium Compressor recipes. No circuits and no modes: the recipe picks the map. It runs only while the KEE's hole is §bopen§r. When the hole closes it pauses, keeps its recipe and resumes when the hole reopens.

The hole sets the bonus when a recipe starts:
- §bparallel 8 × voltage tier × ⌊√M⌋§r: at UIV (tier 11), 352 at 16 SM and 704 at 64 SM;
- §bspeed × (3200 / M) / 50§r, between 1 and 4: ×4 at 16 SM or less, ×1 at 64 SM or more.
The module costs the hole nothing.

§e§lAUTOMATE§r Plain GT: ME input and output buses. The module's GUI says why it waits (hole closed, KEE not formed, KEE not loaded).

[note]At Kerr T2 it also runs §lKerr Densification§r, which needs a hole of at least 128 SM (UMV chapter). Built a Kerr before the modules were machines? Craft the old Compressor Module block on its own into this controller.[/note]

§a§lDONE WHEN§r you hold the module controller (HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL).
